blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Joint brain tumor segmentation and classification models are computationally intensive, limiting their training on resource-constrained edge platforms and restricting privacy-preserving Federated Learning FL in the Internet of Medical Things IoMT. Existing approaches either perform both tasks on GPU-equipped workstations or support only classification on edge devices. To address this gap, this work proposes a lightweight multitask FL framework for joint segmentation and classification through local edge training. A shared pretrained LiteMedSAM encoder with TinyViT extracts features for a coordinate-attention-based segmentation decoder and a segmentation-guided classification head, eliminating a separate feature extractor. Selective encoder freezing retains 95\% trainable parameters while reducing on-device training costs. The proposed framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory testbed of five resource-constrained edge clients using 1,200 T1-weighted MRI samples. It achieves 94.20\% classification accuracy, 88.53\% DSC, 83.68\% IoU, and 99.87\% ROC-AUC. Its classification accuracy remains within 0.6\% of the GPU-trained baseline of 95.21\% across five FL rounds. The attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82\% and 4.60\%, respectively, with 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. On edge hardware, the framework achieves 46.54 s inference latency, 52.8\% CPU utilization, and a peak temperature of 65$^\circ$C without thermal throttling. Its inference latency is observed to be 6.4--10.5 times lower than that of existing frameworks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge platforms.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Brain tumors are life-threatening diseases that essentially demand early and accurate diagnosis for effective neuro-oncological treatment and improved clinical outcomes, particularly for gliomas, meningiomas, and pituitary tumors [ 1 , 2 ] . The diagnosis involves tumor segmentation to delineate the region and classification to identify its category. These tasks are mutually dependent, as precise spatial delineation of the lesion directly informs its classification. While centralized training is effective, aggregating multi-source MRI scans introduces severe privacy and regulatory challenges [ 3 , 4 ] . Additionally, transferring high-dimensional data to centralized servers incurs heavy bandwidth requirements, high latency, and security vulnerabilities during wireless communication [ 5 ] . The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) connects medical imaging systems and low-cost computing devices across healthcare facilities, enabling data processing closer to its source. It aligns with Industry 5.0 priorities of human-centricity, sustainability, and resilience. In this context, Federated Learning (FL) offers a practical approach to edge-assisted distributed learning, wherein hospitals train models locally and exchange model updates rather than raw MRI scans. This is particularly relevant because individual hospitals often possess limited, site-specific datasets, while data protection laws, and institutional policies restrict centralized data sharing. FL also allows models to accommodate variations in patient populations and imaging systems across hospitals.
blocks.zh: 脑瘤是威胁生命的疾病,基本上要求及早和准确地诊断有效的神经肿瘤治疗和改善临床结果,特别是胶原瘤、脑膜瘤和垂体瘤[1、2]。 诊断涉及肿瘤分解,以划分区域,并进行分类以确定其类别。 这些任务是相互依存的,因为损害的精确的空间划分直接为其分类提供了依据。 虽然集中培训是有效的,但聚合多源核磁共振扫描带来了严重的隐私和监管挑战[3,4]. 此外,将高维度数据转移到集中式服务器,在无线通信过程中会产生沉重的带宽要求、高度延迟和安全弱点[5]。 医疗物联网(IOMT)将医疗成像系统和低成本计算设备连接到各保健设施,使数据处理更接近其来源。 它与工业以人为中心的5.0优先事项、可持续性和复原力相一致。 在这方面,联邦学习为边缘辅助分布式学习提供了实用方法,医院在当地培训模型,交换模型更新,而不是原始核磁共振扫描。 这一点特别重要,因为个别医院往往拥有有限的、针对具体地点的数据集,而数据保护法和机构政策限制了集中的数据共享。 FL还允许模型能够容纳患者群体和全医院成像系统的变化.

blocks.en: However, FL places a training burden on edge devices, where limited memory, CPU capacity, and energy make deploying large Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) difficult. Existing joint segmentation–classification methods further exacerbate these challenges. Most state-of-the-art works use separate networks for the two tasks, leading to redundant feature extraction as well as increased computational and parameter costs [ 6 , 7 ] . Although encoder-sharing multi-task models improve integration, recent hybrid designs have grown to 37 M–109 M parameters and run only on GPUs [ 8 , 9 ] . Conversely, the few edge-deployable models achieve small footprints by omitting segmentation entirely and support only inference, while requiring GPU-based training [ 10 ] . Moreover, state-of-the-art work on medical diagnosis has not sufficiently reported practical post-federated-learning deployment performance metrics for joint segmentation and classification. Crucially, essential deployment metrics, such as inference latency, memory footprint, and thermal behavior, remain largely undocumented for resource-constrained IoMT devices. This leaves a critical gap between model-level performance and real-world deployability, as the feasibility of local training and execution on low-cost edge hardware has not been sufficiently demonstrated. Addressing this gap is essential to translating the Industry 5.0 principles of privacy, sustainability, and resilience into practical medical Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems.
blocks.zh: 然而,FL将训练负担放在边缘设备上,在边缘设备中,有限的内存,CPU容量,能量使得部署大型的革命神经网络(CNN)变得困难. 现有的联合分类方法进一步加剧了这些挑战。 大多数最先进的作品都为这两项任务使用独立的网络,导致冗余的特征提取以及增加计算和参数成本[6,7]. 虽然编码器共享多任务模型改进了集成,但最近的混合设计已经发展到37个M–109 M参数,并且只在GPU上运行[8,9]. 反之,少数边缘可部署模式通过完全省略分解并仅支持推论而实现小足迹,同时需要基于GPU的训练[10]. 此外,关于医疗诊断的最新工作没有充分报告用于联合分类和分类的实用的联邦后学习部署业绩衡量标准。 关键的是,基本部署指标,如推断延迟、记忆足迹和热行为,对于资源紧张的IOMT设备,基本上没有记录。 这就留下了模型一级性能与现实世界可部署性之间的重大差距,因为当地在低成本边缘硬件上培训和执行的可行性尚未得到充分证明。 解决这一差距对于将行业5.0的隐私、可持续性和复原力原则转化为实用的医疗人工智能系统至关重要。

blocks.en: The major contributions are mentioned as follows: • An FL-aided IoMT framework is proposed that trains joint brain tumor segmentation and classification locally on resource-constrained edge clients, unlike state-of-the-art works, which rely entirely on GPU training to perform this joint task. A single shared LiteMedSAM encoder extracts features once and reuses them for both tasks, without an additional feature extractor, thereby substantially reducing computation and communication payloads and making the framework suitable for resource-constrained edge clients. • The proposed framework introduces a coordinate-attention segmentation decoder with progressive channel reduction and a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution-based feature-refinement module, boosting the DSC by 3.82% and IoU by 4.60% at an additional 0.74 GFLOPs of computation. • It applies selective encoder freezing to reduce on-device training computation while maintaining model performance across federated communication rounds, ensuring data privacy by exchanging only model weights rather than raw local data. • The proposed framework has been experimentally evaluated in laboratory environment. It is trained on resource-constrained embedded computing client platform without thermal throttling, unlike GPU-dependent frameworks that fail or degrade on edge hardware. Compared to the state-of-the-art works on brain tumor detection, the proposed IoMT framework reduces CPU utilization to 52.8% versus 68.5–99%, and lowers per-image latency by 6.4 6.4 to 10.5 10.5 times, while achieving the highest accuracy among frameworks that run on the edge device.

blocks.en: 2 Related Prior Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关的前期工作

blocks.en: Brain tumor analysis from MRI involves segmentation, which delineates the tumor region, and classification, which assigns the tumor type. In task-specific two-stage pipelines, both tasks are performed in sequence by separately trained networks as proposed in [ 6 ] , [ 11 ] , [ 7 ] , and [ 12 ] , which combined U-Net variants with YOLOv2, CapsVGGNet, CNN, and VGG19 classifiers, respectively, with accuracies of 97%, 99%, and 98.7% in the first three frameworks. However, the YOLOv2 classifier in [ 6 ] required 19.83 M parameters and 16 GB of GPU memory. In [ 11 ] , generalization and interpretability were not validated in the existing framework. Segmentation raised four-class accuracy only from 98.7% to 98.8% in [ 7 ] , and achieved a validation DSC of 75% despite 98% pixel accuracy in [ 12 ] , indicating overfitting. This redundant feature extraction added cost without a proportional classification gain. Multi-task designs removed redundant feature extraction and training at each stage by using a shared encoder, achieving DSCs of 0.92 and 0.86 with 97% accuracy in [ 13 ] and [ 14 ] , respectively. However, [ 13 ] required both a mask and a label per image, whereas BT-Net [ 14 ] used separate datasets at the cost of a lower DSC. These frameworks captured only local features, missing global tumor information, and offered no interpretability. Accuracy-driven hybrids addressed these limitations at high computational cost, i.e., in [ 8 ] fused CNN and Vision Transformer features with Grad-CAM, SHAP, and LIME XAIs, and the model in [ 9 ] combined CVAE-based synthesis, UNETR segmentation, and ResNet50–VGG16 classification, achieving DSC of 0.966 for WT and 97.45% and accuracies of 99.18% and 99.35%, respectively. However, it requires ≈ \approx 36.96 M and ≈ \approx 109.4 M parameters, with the latter taking 1.65 s per image on an RTX 4090 GPU.

blocks.en: Deployment-oriented studies targeted distributed and low-resource settings. In [ 15 ] , IoMT transmission was followed by RU-Net segmentation, BWO-GA feature selection, and AlexNet classification at the receiver, reporting 99.97% segmentation and 99.98% classification accuracy. However, its three independent modules increased complexity, and performance degraded when processing unseen images. The model was further processed centrally across all images. In [ 10 ] , a 2.8 M-parameter wavelet-attention CNN achieved 95.88% four-class accuracy on a Raspberry Pi 5, but performed only classification and was trained centrally on a Tesla P100 GPU. Thus, the reviewed frameworks mainly performed joint segmentation and classification on GPU workstations, with limited attention to on-device execution and training on resource-constrained hardware, revealing the following gaps: • Redundant feature extraction in [ 6 , 11 , 7 , 12 ] and heavy hybrid models in [ 8 , 9 ] exceed edge budgets. While the only edge model exempts the segmentation task in [ 10 ] and performs only the classification task. Hence, a single lightweight encoder serving both tasks is required. • CNN-based multi-task models lost segmentation accuracy in [ 13 , 14 ] , while transformer hybrids regained it only at high cost in [ 8 , 9 ] . Hence, a decoder that recovers spatial and global context with minimal computation is required. • Training was confined to GPU or cloud platforms for the models used in [ 6 , 12 , 9 , 10 ] , and in [ 15 ] , which sent raw images centrally. Hence, privacy-preserving training is required in which edge clients update part of the model locally and share only its weights. • Evaluation was limited to GPU workstations in [ 9 ] , with resource usage reported only for a single task in [ 10 ] . Hence, on-device training and evaluation reporting CPU utilization, thermal stability, and latency is required.

blocks.zh: 3. 拟议的脑肿瘤检测IOMT系统概述

In order to ensure patient privacy, raw images never leave the client, and only the model parameters 𝜽 = { 𝐖 , 𝐛 } \boldsymbol{\theta}=\{\mathbf{W},\mathbf{b}\} are exchanged, where 𝐖 \mathbf{W} and 𝐛 \mathbf{b} represent weights and biases, respectively. Since segmentation and classification share a single encoder, each client optimizes one parameter set for both tasks by minimizing the joint loss expressed as: ℒ i ​ ( 𝜽 ) = 1 n i ​ ∑ j = 1 n i [ λ s ​ ℒ seg ​ ( S j , m j ) + λ c ​ ℒ cls ​ ( y ^ j , y j ) ] , \mathcal{L}_{i}(\boldsymbol{\theta})=\frac{1}{n_{i}}\sum_{j=1}^{n_{i}}\Big[\lambda_{s}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{seg}}(S_{j},m_{j})+\lambda_{c}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cls}}(\hat{y}_{j},y_{j})\Big], (1) where ℒ i ​ ( 𝜽 ) \mathcal{L}_{i}(\boldsymbol{\theta}) is the local loss of client i i for the model parameters 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} . n i n_{i} denotes the number of training samples at client i i , and j j is the sample index. ℒ seg \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{seg}} and ℒ cls \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cls}} denote the segmentation and cross-entropy classification losses, respectively. The weights λ s \lambda_{s} and λ c \lambda_{c} balance the segmentation and classification losses. In each communication round ( r r ), client i i receives the global model 𝜽 r − 1 \boldsymbol{\theta}^{r-1} and performs local training on its dataset as follows: 𝜽 i r = 𝜽 r − 1 − η ∇ ℒ i ( 𝜽 r − 1 ) , \boldsymbol{\theta}_{i}^{r}=\boldsymbol{\theta}^{r-1}-\eta\,\nabla\mathcal{L}_{i}(\boldsymbol{\theta}^{r-1}), (2) where η \eta is the learning rate and ∇ ℒ i \nabla\mathcal{L}_{i} is the gradient of the local loss. The node executes E E local optimization epochs, updating only the designated trainable parameters while freezing the early encoder layers, thereby reducing on-device computational overhead. For experimental consistency, all clients are assumed to employ identical and fixed local training configurations, i.e., optimizer, learning rate η \eta , batch size, and number of local epochs E E in every round, without client-specific hyperparameter adaptation. Thereby, isolating the effect of the proposed framework from variations in local optimization settings under heterogeneous deployment conditions [ 16 ] .The server further aggregates the client updates via Federated Averaging (FedAvg) using: 𝜽 r = ∑ i = 1 K n i n ​ 𝜽 i r , n = ∑ i = 1 K n i , \boldsymbol{\theta}^{r}=\sum_{i=1}^{K}\frac{n_{i}}{n}\,\boldsymbol{\theta}_{i}^{r},\qquad n=\sum_{i=1}^{K}n_{i}, (3) where n i n_{i} denotes the local dataset size at client i i and K K is the number of participating clients. It reduces to a uniform average over R R communication rounds due to balanced client dataset sizes. The resulting cumulative communication overhead ( C comm C_{\mathrm{comm}} ) is estimated using: C comm = R ⋅ K ⋅ ( P down + P up ) , P ≈ q ​ | 𝜽 | , C_{\mathrm{comm}}=R\cdot K\cdot\big(P_{\mathrm{down}}+P_{\mathrm{up}}\big),\qquad P\approx q\,|\boldsymbol{\theta}|, (4) where P down P_{\mathrm{down}} and P up P_{\mathrm{up}} denote the per-client downlink and uplink payload sizes, respectively. The global server–edge client communication link is assumed to be reliable, with no packet loss or retransmission delays; thus, the overhead in Eq.  ( 4 ) depends solely on payload size. Each payload depends on the number of model parameters | 𝜽 | |\boldsymbol{\theta}| and the number of bits q q used to represent each parameter. The client model jointly produces the segmentation output S j S_{j} and class prediction y ^ j \hat{y}_{j} using a single parameter set 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} , whose size determines the communication payload in Eq. ( 4 ) and whose depth influences the local training cost in Eq. ( 2 ). In order to meet the resource-constrained design criteria, the proposed IoMT framework integrates pixel-level tumor segmentation and four-class tumor classification into a single end-to-end architecture using a lightweight pretrained encoder. The proposed framework shares encoder features, reducing redundant computation and communication overhead by requiring each client to train and transmit only one parameter set, unlike two-stage approaches that train separate models for each task. The detailed architecture of the proposed framework is presented in Fig. 1 .

blocks.en: 3.1 Lightweight Feature Extraction Encoder
blocks.zh: 3.1 轻质特性提取编码器

blocks.en: The feature extraction stage is based on LiteMedSAM, whose lightweight TinyViT-based image encoder is computationally more efficient than large vision backbones [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] as represented in Fig. 1 . Instead of fine-tuning all encoder parameters, the proposed framework selectively freezes TinyViT layers and unfreezes the encoder neck, so that the majority of the pretrained weights and biases are subsequently optimized during training. This selective fine-tuning reduces the number of trainable parameters and irrelevant weight updates, lowering computational requirements without compromising feature extraction for downstream tasks. The proposed lightweight encoder transforms the 256 × 256 256\times 256 input MRI into a compact high-level feature map.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: The proposed IoMT-based framework for brain tumor detection has been experimentally evaluated in order to investigate its classification performance, federated learning effectiveness, and computational feasibility under the considered experimental setup.
blocks.zh: 已经对拟议的基于IOMT的脑瘤检测框架进行了实验性评价,以便在其考虑的实验设置下调查其分类性能、联合学习效果和计算可行性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup and Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置和培训战略

blocks.en: The proposed IoMT-based framework has been implemented in a laboratory environment as shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,在实验室环境中实施了拟议的基于综合管理技术的框架。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Experimental Setup of the Proposed IoMT-based Framework
blocks.zh: 图 2:拟议基于IMT框架的实验设置

blocks.en: It is highlighted that the server-side computation has been executed on a workstation equipped with an Intel Xeon Silver 4214R CPU operating at 2.40 GHz with 12 cores, an NVIDIA RTX A4000 GPU with 16 GB memory, and 64 GB DDR4 RAM.
blocks.zh: 突出显示服务器侧计算是在一个配备了Intel Xeon Silver 4214R CPU的工作站上执行的,该工作站运行于2.40 GHz,拥有12个核心,一个NVIDIA RTX A4000 GPU,拥有16 GB内存,以及64 GB DDR4 RAM.

blocks.en: A total of 1200 class-balanced T1-weighted MRI samples are considered in this work, comprising Meningioma, Pituitary, and Glioma samples from the publicly available Figshare dataset [ 25 ] and no-tumor samples from the Sartaj dataset [ 26 ] . Instead of a single centralized training configuration, the samples were divided into 600 for offline GPU-based global training, 360 for federated learning on resource-constrained clients, and 240 for testing, corresponding to 50%, 30%, and 20%, respectively. The global training uses 480 samples for training, 60 for validation, and 60 for testing. The 360-sample client partition was sized to the compute and memory budget of the 16 GB Raspberry Pi 5 [ 27 ] and distributed equally across five clients, each holding 72 samples with a 40:16:16 samples for training:validation:test split. The remaining 240 samples form a held-out external test set shared by the global and federated configurations.
blocks.zh: 这项工作共考虑了1200个分类平衡的T1加权核磁共振样本,其中包括来自公开的Figshare数据集的Meningioma、Pituitary和Glioma样本以及来自Sartaj数据集的无肿瘤样本[25]。 与单一的集中培训配置不同,样本分为600个,用于基于GPU的离线全球培训,360个用于在受资源限制的客户上进行联邦学习,240个用于测试,分别相当于50%、30%和20%。 全球培训使用480个样本进行培训,60个样本用于验证,60个样本用于测试。 360-sample客户端分区大小为16GB Raspberry Pi 5[27]的计算和内存预算,并平均分布在5个客户端,每个客户持有72个样本,一个40:16:16的样本用于培训:验证:测试拆分. 其余240个样本构成全球和联邦组合共享的搁置外部测试。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparative Evaluation of Centralized and Distributed Learning Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 集中和分配学习成绩的比较评价

blocks.en: The client-based model is trained on GPU-accelerated weights and achieves classification accuracy close to the global baseline of 95.21%, as shown in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 基于客户端的模型通过GPU加速权重进行训练,并实现接近全球基准95.21%的分类精度,如图3所示.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Performance Evaluation of the Proposed IoMT Framework Across Federated Rounds
blocks.zh: 图3:对拟议的跨联邦回合综合管理技术框架的绩效评价

blocks.en: The accuracy remains close to the global baseline of 95.21%, with relative changes ranging from a 0.59% decrement to a 0.08% increment across the five federated rounds.
blocks.zh: 准确度仍然接近95.21%的全球基线,五个联邦回合的相对变化从0.59%下降到0.08%的递增。

blocks.en:
It can be observed that the overall accuracy closely tracks the global baseline, varying from -0.59% to +0.08%. Round 2 achieves the highest segmentation fidelity, with relative improvements in DS and IoU of 2.00% and 2.95%, respectively. Subsequent rounds exhibit performance degradation across both overlap metrics despite pixel accuracy persisting above 99.9%, highlighting its limited sensitivity to segmentation degradation. This indicates that local weight and bias updates on low-power hardware maintain performance close to that of the globally trained model. DSC and IoU exceed the global baselines of 90.04% and 84.31% in Round 1 and Round 2, peaking at 91.84% and 86.80%, which increases by 1.80% and 2.49%, respectively. Since both metrics move in the same direction in every round, this gain reflects a generalized improvement in weight updates. Round 2 provides the strongest performance, with accuracy of 95.24%, DSC of 91.84%, IoU of 86.80%, and pixel accuracy of 99.98%, all exceeding the global performance metrics by +0.03, +1.80, +2.49, and +0.06, respectively.
While pixel accuracy remains between 99.92% and 99.99% across all rounds, without highlighting substantial variation across rounds. DSC and IoU then decline to 85.15% and 79.88% by Round 5, showing that local weight updates adapt the shared feature representations to client-specific data distributions. Hence, the model potentially improves client-level adaptation and generalization rather than simply preserving the globally fine-tuned segmentation weights. Furthermore, the communication payload remains nearly constant at approximately 42.2 MB downlink and 48.7 MB uplink per round, varying by less than 0.05 MB, which amounts to 210.86 MB downlink and 243.65 MB uplink per client over five rounds, totaling 454.51MB. As a single multitask framework serves both segmentation and classification, separate payloads of comparable size for two independent pipelines are avoided, making the communication design suitable for resource-constrained edge clients.
blocks.zh:
可以看出,总体准确性密切跟踪全球基线,从-0.59%到+0.08%不等。 第2轮实现分化忠诚度最高,DS和IoU的相对改善分别为2.00%和2.95%. 尽管像素精度持续超过99.9%,但随后的几轮显示两种重叠度的性能退化,突出表明其对分解退化的敏感性有限。 这表明低功率硬件的局部重量和偏差更新保持了接近全球训练模式的性能. DSC和IoU超过了第1轮和第2轮的全球基线90.04%和84.31%,最高达到91.84%和86.80%,分别增长了1.80%和2.49%. 由于两个度量衡在每一回合都朝同一方向移动,这一增益反映出重量更新的普遍改善. 第二回合提供最强性能,精度为95.24%,DSC为91.84%,IoU为86.80%,像素精度为99.98%,均分别超过全球性能指标+0.03,+1.80,+2.49和+0.06.
虽然所有回合的像素精度保持在99.92%至99.99%之间,但没有突出各回合之间的巨大差异。 DSC和IoU随后到第5轮时下降至85.15%和79.88%,显示本地的权重更新将共享的功能表达方式适应客户特定的数据分布. 因此,该模式有可能改进客户一级的适应和概括,而不是仅仅保留全球微调分化权重。 此外,通信有效载荷几乎保持不变,约为每轮42.2 MB 下行链路和48.7 MB 上行链路,变化小于0.05 MB,相当于每客户5轮210.86 MB下行链路和243.65 MB上行链路,总计454.51 MB。 由于单一的多任务框架既服务于分区又服务于分类,因此避免了两个独立管道的大小相当的单独有效载荷,使通信设计适合资源紧张的边缘客户。

blocks.en: 4.3 Impact of Trainable Parameters on Model Performance and Hardware Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.3 可训练参数对模型性能和硬件效率的影响

blocks.en: In the proposed framework, the percentage of trainable parameters is systematically varied from 100% to 70%, as shown in Table 1 . Freezing 5% of the parameters and utilizing 95% trainable parameters decreases the number of trainable parameters by 489,565 and training FLOPs by 3.98 G, as shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,在拟议框架中,可培训参数的百分比从100%到70%不等。 如表1所示,冻结5%的参数并使用95%的可训练参数,使可训练参数的数量减少489 565个,训练FLOP减少3.98 G。

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance Evaluation Under Different Trainable Parameter Configurations
blocks.zh: 表1:不同可训练参数配置下的绩效评价

blocks.en:
In comparison with the performance of 100% trainable parameters, the 95% trainable parameters exhibited changes in performance of -0.15%, -0.08%, -0.25%, -0.01%, and -0.02% in Accuracy, DSC, IoU, Pixel Accuracy, and ROC-AUC, respectively. The 95% to 90% reduction in trainable parameters resulted in a variation of -0.24% in accuracy, -0.34% in DSC, and -0.46% in IoU. At 70% trainable parameters, the computational cost decreases to 55.69 G FLOPs, representing a reduction of 23.86 G FLOPs compared with 100% trainable parameters.
This configuration resulted in performance drop of 1.35% in accuracy, 1.64% in DSC, 2.33% in IoU, 0.09% in pixel-accuracy , and 0.22% in ROC-AUC, compared with the 100% trainable-parameter configuration. In comparison, the 95% trainable configuration reduces the computational cost to 75.57 G FLOPs, with corresponding performance of -0.15%, -0.08%, -0.25%, and -0.02% in accuracy, DSC, IoU, and ROC-AUC, respectively. This signifies that, with 95% of parameters trainable, compared with 100% trainable, it largely preserves distinct multiclass tumor features and performs multi-tasking effectively.
The 95% freezing configuration offers an optimal trade-off between computational efficiency and task-specific adaptation, while retaining most of the extracted features.

这种配置导致性能下降1.35%精度下降,DSC下降1.64%,IoU下降2.33%,像素精确度下降0.09%,ROC-AUC下降0.22%,而列车可参数配置为100%. 相比之下,95%的可训练配置将计算成本降低到75.57 G FLOP,相应的性能分别为−0.15%,−0.08%,−0.25%,以及−0.02%的精度,DSC,IoU,和ROC-AUC. 这表明,由于95%的参数是可训练的,而100%是可训练的,它在很大程度上保留了不同的多类肿瘤特征,并有效地开展了多任务。
95%的冻结配置在计算效率和任务特定适应之间提供了最佳的权衡,同时保留了大部分提取的特性.

blocks.en: 4.4 Components-wise Ablation Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 分部分分析

blocks.en:
In order to determine the individual contribution of the proposed framework, the ablation study is conducted using three configurations: (i) M1: Fine-tuned LiteMedSAM + Classification Head; (ii) M2: M1+Coordinate Attention (CA) Module; (iii) M3: M2+Feature Refinement(FR) (Proposed Framework).
In Fig. 4 , the results demonstrate a progressive improvement as each component is added.
blocks.zh:
为了确定拟议框架的个别贡献,利用三种配置进行扩展研究:(一) M1:精细调整的LiteMedSAM+分类头目;(二) M2: M1+协调注意(CA)模块;(三) M3: M2+ Feature Refinement(FR)(拟议框架).
在图4中,结果显示随着每个组成部分的加入而逐步改善。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Ablation Study of the Proposed Framework
blocks.zh: 图4:对拟议框架的研究

blocks.en: The baseline M1 achieves an accuracy of 92.84%, DSC of 84.71%, and IoU of 79.08%. In M2, adding the lightweight coordinate attention module to the baseline M1 improves accuracy by 0.97%, DSC by 2.21%, and IoU by 2.63%. In M3, the addition of the feature refinement further improves accuracy by 0.39%, DSC by 1.61%, and IoU by 1.97% compared to M2. In comparison with the baseline M1 and the proposed framework M3, overall improvements of 1.36% in accuracy, 3.82% in DSC, and 4.60% in IoU are observed. Thus, the ablation results indicate that the additional architectural components contribute not only to multi-class classification but also improve the spatial segmentation of the tumor region. Although the computational complexity increases as the component progresses from M1 to M3, the proposed framework provides additional representational capability with a comparatively controlled computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 基线M1的精度为92.84%,DSC为84.71%,IoU为79.08%. 在M2中,在基线M1中加入轻量座坐标关注模块,精度提高0.97%,DSC提高2.21%,IoU提高2.63%. 在M3中,增加特性的精度进一步提高了0.39%,DSC提高了1.61%,IoU提高了1.97%,而M2. 与基线M1和拟议框架M3相比,观察到总体改进情况如下:准确度为1.36%,DSC为3.82%,IoU为4.60%。 因此,衰减结果表明,额外的建筑构件不仅有助于多类分类,而且改善了肿瘤区域的空间分化. 虽然计算的复杂性随着构成部分从M1发展到M3而增加,但拟议框架提供了额外的代表能力,具有相对控制的计算间接费用。

blocks.en: These improvements are accompanied by a gradual increase in computational complexity and parameter count. The total FLOPs increase from 78.81 G in M1 to 79.18 G in M2 and 79.55 G in M3, while trainable parameters increase from 9,108,642 to 9,226,954 and 9,301,735, respectively. The corresponding CPU utilization rises from 50.7% to 52.8%, RAM usage from 6.88 GB to 7.01 GB, and CPU temperature from 58.9 ∘ C to 60.6 ∘ C. Subsequently, the proposed M3 introduces only 0.74 G in additional total FLOPs and 193,093 additional trainable parameters compared to M1, while improving DSC by 3.82%, IoU by 4.60%, and classification accuracy by 1.36%. These results indicate that the additional computational cost is accompanied by a significant improvement in performance quality, with a comparatively modest increase in computational resources.

FLOP总数从M1的78.81G增加到M2的79.18G和M3的79.55G,而可训练参数分别从9 108 642增加到9 226 954和9 301 735。 相应的CPU利用率从50.7%上升到52.8%,RAM使用率从6.88GB上升到7.01GB,CPU温度从58.9QC上升到60.6QC. 随后,拟议的M3在额外的FLOP总量中仅引入了0.74 G,与M1相比增加了193,093个可列车参数,同时将DSC改进3.82%,IoU改进4.60%,分类精度提高1.36%. 这些结果显示,在增加计算费用的同时,业绩质量显著提高,计算资源相对较少增加。

blocks.en: 4.5 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Frameworks on Edge Hardware
blocks.zh: 4.5 与边际硬件最新框架的比较

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the proposed IoMT framework with ten state-of-the-art brain tumor diagnosis frameworks, all evaluated on the same dataset using a 16 GB Raspberry Pi 5 client.
blocks.zh: 表2将拟议的IOMT框架与10个最先进的脑瘤诊断框架进行比较,这些框架都使用16GB Raspberry Pi 5客户端在同一数据集上评价.

blocks.en: Table 2: Comparison of the Proposed Framework with State-of-the-Art Joint Segmentation and Classification Methods in Terms of Computational, Thermal, and Diagnostic Performance
blocks.zh: 表2:拟议框架与计算、热学和诊断性能方面最先进的联合分类和分类方法的比较

The comparison covers diagnostic performance, thermal behavior, and computational efficiency.

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Diagnostic Performance
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 诊断性能

blocks.en: Existing frameworks largely rely on separately trained segmentation and classification networks, in which the classifier does not explicitly exploit the predicted tumor region. Under edge execution, the existing frameworks achieve accuracies of only 91.89–93.58%, and those performing segmentation achieve DSC values of 83.45–86.92% [ 7 , 8 , 10 , 11 , 14 , 15 ] . In contrast, the proposed framework addresses this repetitive training through segmentation-guided feature reuse, achieving 94.20% accuracy, 88.53% DSC, 83.68% IoU, 99.89% pixel accuracy, and 99.87% ROC-AUC, the highest values on all five metrics among the frameworks executed on the edge client. The shared encoder with U-Net decoder and MLP classifier [ 13 ] , CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [ 9 ] , Residual U-Net+FT-CNN [ 12 ] , and ResNet-18 U-Net+YOLOv2 [ 6 ] report higher accuracies of 95.29–98.56%. However, these values reflect a global GPU-based evaluation, since the resource demands of these architectures could not be accommodated by resource-constrained training on edge devices. Hence, the proposed framework provides competitive, effective diagnostic performance in comparison with GPU-scale models while completing all federated rounds on the edge client.
blocks.zh: 现有框架主要依赖经过单独培训的分类和分类网络,其中分类者没有明确利用预测的肿瘤区域。 在边缘执行中,现有框架只达到91.89-93.58%的速率,而那些进行分割的人达到83.45-86.92%的DSC值[7、8、10、11、14、15]。 与此相反,拟议框架通过分解制导特性再利用来解决这种重复培训,实现了94.20%的精确度、88.53%的DSC、83.68%的IoU、99.89%的像素精度和99.87%的ROC-AUC,这是在边缘客户端执行的所有五个参数中最高的数值。 与U-Net解码器和MLP分类器共享编码器 [13],CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [9],残存 U-Net+FT-CNN [12],以及ResNet-18 U-Net+YOLOv2 [6] 报告较高的增长率为95.29–98.56%. 然而,这些数值反映了基于全球GPU的评价,因为这些架构的资源需求无法通过对边缘设备的资源有限的培训来满足。 因此,与GPU尺度模型相比,拟议框架提供了竞争性的、有效的诊断性能,同时完成了边缘客户的所有联合回合。

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Thermal Behavior

ResNet-18 U-Net+YOLOv2 [ 6 ] , VggVU-ED [ 8 ] , CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [ 9 ] , Residual U-Net+FT-CNN [ 12 ] , and the shared encoder model in [ 13 ] reach peak temperatures of 85 ∘ C, while CapsNet+VGG [ 11 ] and SBTC-Net [ 15 ] reach 82.1 ∘ C and 82 ∘ C, respectively. In UNet+39-layer CNN [ 7 ] , CapsNet+VGG [ 11 ] , and SBTC-Net [ 15 ] , the processor frequency is reduced to 1.5 GHz in later rounds, lowering the effective computational capacity and extending training time. The proposed framework extracts features once and reuses them for both tasks, utilizing a partially frozen shared encoder. This, in contrast, limits the sustained processor load, maintaining an average temperature of 60 ∘ C and a peak of 65 ∘ C at a fixed 1.5 GHz clock, with no throttling events across all five federated rounds. The proposed framework achieves thermal performance comparable to that of PWT+CNN+Self-Attention [ 10 ] . This existing architecture performs only the classification task and skips the segmentation task, with average and peak temperatures of 58.6 ∘ C and 64.2 ∘ C. In contrast, the proposed framework jointly performs segmentation and classification tasks, with each round 7.3 times faster at slightly higher average and peak temperatures of 60 ∘ C and 65 ∘ C, respectively.
blocks.zh: ResNet-18 U-Net+YOLOv2 [6],VggVU-ED [8],CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [9],残存的U-Net+FT-CN [12],以及[13]中的共享编码器模型达到峰值温度85°C,而CapsNet+VGG [11]和SBTC-Net [15]分别达到82.1°C和82°C. 在UNet+39层的CNN [7],CapsNet+VGG [11],以及SBTC-Net [15]中,处理器频率在以后的回合中降低到1.5GHz,降低了有效的计算能力并延长了训练时间. 拟议框架抽出特性,并重新用于这两项任务,使用部分冻结的共享编码器。 相比之下,这限制了持续的处理器负载,在固定的1.5GHz时钟上保持平均60QQ C和65QQC的峰值,所有5个联邦回合均没有节奏事件. 拟议框架的热性能与PWT+CNN+自留[10]相当。 这种现存的架构只履行分类任务,并跳过分割任务,平均和峰值温度分别为58.6 QQ C和64.2 QC. 与此相反,拟议框架联合执行分块和分类任务,每轮7.3倍,平均略高,最高温度分别为60°C和65°C。

blocks.en: 4.5.3 Computational Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.5.3 计算效率

blocks.en:
VggVU-ED [ 8 ] , CapsNet+VGG [ 11 ] , Residual U-Net+FT-CNN [ 12 ] , CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [ 9 ] , and ResNet-18 U-Net+YOLOv2 [ 6 ] operate at 92–99% CPU utilization, leaving insufficient headroom for gradient computation and federated communication due to the redundant feature extraction across each separate network, saturating the processor computational memory.
VggVU-ED [ 8 ] requires 13.2 GB of RAM, and its training process is terminated by the operating system at Round 3, due to memory exhaustion. CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [ 9 ] requires 15.6 GB of RAM with only 0.2 GB of headroom, while CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [ 9 ] and Residual U-Net+FT-CNN [ 12 ] consume 98% of the memory bandwidth, and SBTC-Net [ 15 ] consumes 89%. As these architectures are designed for GPU workstations, their memory and processing requirements exceed the budget of an edge-device-based, resource-constrained client. The models in [ 13 , 9 , 12 , 6 ] exceed the on-device training budget beyond the first round. In contrast, the proposed framework addresses this by using a joint segmentation and classification approach with a single shared encoder. This eliminates the need for redundant training for feature extraction, reducing the number of trainable parameters. It operates at 52.8% CPU utilization, 7.01 GB of RAM with 8.81 GB of headroom, and 55% memory bandwidth utilization, leaving sufficient resources for local training and weight exchange among the global server and client-based server.

VggVU-ED [8] 需要13.2 GB的RAM,由于内存耗尽,其训练过程在第三回合被操作系统终止. CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [9]需要15.6GB的RAM,只有0.2GB的头室,而CVAE-UNETR-ResNet50-VGG16 [9]和残留的U-Net+FT-CNN [12]消耗98%的内存带宽,SBTC-Net [15]消耗89%. 由于这些架构是为GPU工作站设计的,因此其内存和处理要求超过了基于边缘的,受资源限制的客户端的预算. [13,9,12,6]中的型号超过了第一轮之后的机修培训预算. 与此相反,拟议框架通过采用使用单一共享编码器的联合分割和分类方法来解决这一问题。 这消除了对特征提取进行冗余培训的需要,减少了可训练参数的数量. 它以52.8%的CPU利用率运行,7.01GB的RAM拥有8.81GB的头室,以及55%的内存带宽利用率,为全球服务器和基于客户端的服务器之间的局部培训和权重交换留下足够的资源.

blocks.en: A low memory footprint alone, however, does not ensure efficient execution. PWT+CNN+Self-Attention [ 10 ] uses only 4.25 GB of RAM and 35% memory bandwidth, yet requires 350 s/image and 326.67 min/round, while BT-Net [ 14 ] requires 490 s/image and 457.34 min/round. In contrast, the proposed framework performs the entire brain tumor diagnosis by sharing encoder feature maps between segmentation and classification and processing them through a lightweight decoder and classification head, reducing the per-image processing time to 46.54 s and the round time to 45 min. Consequently, the proposed framework achieves a per-image processing time 6.4 times lower than that of SBTC-Net [ 15 ] and 10.5 times lower than that of BT-Net [ 14 ] , which represent the fastest and slowest existing frameworks with measurable latency, respectively. Likewise, the joint task reduces the round time by 7.3 and 10.2 times, respectively, as compared to PWT+CNN+Self-Attention [ 10 ] and BT-Net [ 14 ] , which complete all federated rounds without throttling.
blocks.zh: 然而,仅凭记忆力不足并不能确保有效执行。 PWT+CNN+自留[10]仅使用4.25GB的内存带宽和35%的内存带宽,然而需要350s/image和326.67min/round,而BT-Net[14]则需要490s/image和457.34min/round. 相比之下,拟议框架通过在分解和分类之间共享编码器特征图,并通过轻量级解码器和分类头来进行处理,实现整个脑瘤诊断,将每幅图像的处理时间缩短到46.54秒,圆环时间缩短到45分钟. 因此,拟议框架的每个图像处理时间比SBTC-Net[15]低6.4倍,比BT-Net[14]低10.5倍,后者分别代表了速度最快和速度最快的现有框架,具有可计量的耐久性。 同样,与PWT+CNN+自留[10]和BT-Net[14]相比,联合任务分别减少了7.3倍和10.2倍的圆圈时间,这些圆圈完成所有联赛的回合均没有节奏.

blocks.en: Overall, the existing frameworks are constrained on the edge client by limited processing and memory resources, elevated temperatures, or prolonged round times. The proposed framework addresses each of these through shared feature extraction, segmentation-guided feature reuse and refinement, and selective encoder freezing. Consequently, it provides stable, multi-round, client-based federated training with the highest diagnostic performance among edge-executed frameworks.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,由于加工和内存资源有限,温度升高,或长时间的圆形,现有框架在边缘客户端受到限制. 拟议框架通过共同的特性提取、分解制导特性再利用和完善以及选择性的编码器冻结来解决每一个问题。 因此,它提供稳定、多轮、基于客户的联邦培训,在边缘执行框架中诊断性能最高。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This work experimentally validates the feasibility of joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge devices within an FL-based IoMT system. The proposed architecture eliminates redundant feature extraction by sharing a single LiteMedSAM encoder and reusing segmentation-guided features. It completes all five federated rounds without thermal throttling, achieving 94.20% classification accuracy and 88.53% DSC, the highest among frameworks executed on the same hardware, while its accuracy across the five federated rounds remains within 0.6% of the GPU-trained baseline. The coordinate attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82% and 4.60%, respectively, with only 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. Compared with existing frameworks, the proposed approach achieves 52.8% CPU utilization and 6.4–10.5 times lower per-image processing time. Training 95% of the parameters reduces computation by 3.98 GFLOPs with at most 0.25% degradation in any metric.
blocks.zh: 这项工作在实验上验证了在基于FL的IOMT系统中对资源约束边缘装置进行联合脑瘤分解和分类的可行性. 拟议的架构通过共享单一的LiteMedSAM编码器和重用分区制导特性来消除冗余特性提取. 它完成所有5个联邦回合,没有加热减速,达到94.20%的分类精度和88.53%的DSC,是在同一硬件上执行的框架中最高的,而5个联邦回合的精度仍保持在GPU训练基线的0.6%以内. 坐标关注度和特征改进模块分别将DSC和IoU改进3.82%和4.60%,额外计算时只有0.74 GFLOP. 与现有框架相比,拟议办法实现了 52.8%的CPU利用率和6.4-10.5倍的每个图像处理时间. 95%的参数的培训将计算值减少3.98GFLOP,任何度量的降解率最多为0.25%。

blocks.en: In future work, the proposed framework will be extended from T1-weighted MRI to multimodal MRI with tumor sub-region segmentation, and from five balanced clients to larger client populations with non-identical data distributions across diverse edge platforms. In addition, model quantization and secure aggregation will be investigated to further reduce computational overhead and strengthen privacy during federated weight exchange.
blocks.zh: 在今后的工作中,拟议框架将从T1加权磁共振扩展到肿瘤分区域多模式磁共振,从5个均衡客户扩大到不同边缘平台数据分布不相同的较大客户群。 此外,将对模型量化和安全汇总进行调查,以进一步减少计算间接费用,并在联邦权重交换期间加强隐私。
